# Migrations & Database — Institutional Memory

## Standard Workflow

```
1. Edit schemas/<name>.json        # JSON Schema is source of truth
2. ./scripts/generate.sh           # Regenerates src/schemas/*.py (Pydantic)
3. Edit src/db/models.py           # Extend SQLModel tables manually
4. make migration msg="description" # Alembic autogenerate
5. uv run alembic upgrade head     # Apply migration
6. python scripts/export_openapi.py # Re-export OpenAPI spec
7. cd web && npm run generate:api  # Regenerate TypeScript types
```

## NEVER Edit Generated Files

- `src/schemas/*.py` — generated by `datamodel-codegen` from `schemas/*.json`
- Re-run `./scripts/generate.sh` to update them
- The `pre-edit-guard.sh` hook will block accidental edits

## SQLite Type Compatibility

- Use `String` for enums — SQLite has no native enum type
- `DateTime` stores as ISO 8601 string in SQLite
- No `JSON` column type in SQLite — serialize to `String` with custom validator
- `Boolean` stored as integer (0/1)

## Alembic Behavior

- `--autogenerate` only detects changes to SQLModel table classes
- Does NOT detect: custom constraints added outside models, index renames
- Always review generated migration before applying — may need manual edits
- Migration files live in `migrations/versions/`

## Phone Number Security

- Raw phone numbers NEVER stored in DB
- `caller_id_hash`: HMAC-SHA256 with `PHONE_HASH_PEPPER` (for deduplication)
- `customer_phone_encrypted`: AES-256-GCM with `PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (for WhatsApp delivery)
- Security functions: `src/core/security.py`
- Both keys are 64 hex chars; generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`

## Data Retention

- 90-day auto-purge for: transcripts, encrypted phone numbers, call logs
- Purge job defined in `src/worker.py` (arq cron)
- Only one worker in MVP — cron jobs not "exactly once" across multiple instances

## After Migration Checklist

1. `uv run alembic upgrade head` — apply
2. `python scripts/export_openapi.py` — re-export spec
3. `cd web && npm run generate:api` — regenerate TypeScript
4. Test the affected endpoint in admin or via curl

## Common Pitfalls

- Alembic `current` may show `(head)` even if no migration applied — check with `alembic history`
- Don't run `alembic downgrade` in production without a backup
- SQLite WAL mode enabled for concurrent reads — don't disable it
- Column renames generate a drop+add in SQLite (no `ALTER COLUMN RENAME`) — data migration needed
